quarterly_data.quarter: Amgen press release: FDA APPROVES REDUCED MONITORING TIME FOR FIRST TWO DOSES OF (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The FDA approved an IMDELLTRA (tarlatamab-dlle) label update cutting recommended monitoring after each of the first two doses to 6 to 8 hours from the start of infusion, from the previously recommended 22 to 24 hours, plus a next-day follow-up assessment; Amgen says this may reduce treatment complexity for community oncology practices, where an estimated 80% to 85% of U.S. cancer patients receive care. Reduced monitoring is being evaluated in several ongoing studies that could inform further reductions.
quarterly_data.figure: first two doses: monitoring 6 to 8 hours (was 22 to 24 hours)
